groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk

rows.label: Orokin Ducats
rows.note: common 15, uncommon 45, rare 100; 25 or 65 for vaulted parts at lower rarity

conditions: Baro's 50,000-credit Void Surplus has only a 2% chance at 1,000 Ducats; don't count on it.
bonuses: Rescue or Capture with a fast frame (Titania, Volt, Uriel) is the quickest solo loop; in pub squads pick Defense or Survival so you're not stuck waiting at extraction.
Void Cascade also pays out Arcanes for players who know how to run it.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; two to four stocked visits a year

rows.label: Quanta Vandal
rows.note: arrives built; keep a free weapon slot

conditions: The Kiosk countdown only says when Baro arrives, not what he sells; check the r/Warframe inventory post the day he lands.
MR 10 to buy and level it.
The Tenet Quanta is a separate item with its own Mastery; owning one doesn't cover the other.

disclosures.title: TennoCon
disclosures.body: Baro's TennoCon relay sells his entire catalog to anyone with access, a guaranteed window if you're in.
